article.title: Claude Duet研究預覽擴至印度，個人候補與企業測試分開
article.title_en: Claude Duet research preview reaches India with waitlists and separate business betas
article.summary: Analytics India Magazine報道，Claude Duet研究預覽擴至印度，個人方案候補、Team公開beta及Enterprise私人beta分開處理。
article.summary_en: Analytics India Magazine reports an India expansion of the Duet research preview, separating personal-plan waitlists, Team public beta and Enterprise private beta.
highlights: Pro、Max及Ultra須加入候補，不能等同已獲接入。
公司稱背景代理在發訊息、付款、簽署及刪除資料前須用戶批准。
highlights_en: Pro, Max and Ultra use a waitlist, which does not establish active access.
The company says messages, payments, signatures and deletions require user approval.
article.why: 印度團隊增加按方案申請背景代理的途徑，可先決定哪些客戶資料整理適合交予預覽，哪些對外動作仍需逐次審閱。
article.why_en: Indian teams gain plan-specific routes to background agents and can select data-preparation tasks while retaining review of outward actions.
article.next_step: 印度團隊先確認帳戶實際候補或beta狀態，再用一項客戶會議整理任務檢查背景輸出與發送前批准，通過後才擴大範圍。
article.next_step_en: Indian teams should confirm actual waitlist or beta status, then inspect one client-meeting preparation task and its send-approval step before widening use.
article.detail: 這次按直接報道中的Anthropic說法整理，並非本刊產品實測。研究預覽及beta表示仍處測試階段，個人方案排隊與已啟用的商業帳戶不能混為一談。編輯建議用同一項會議任務記錄代理提出甚麼、做了甚麼及在哪一步要求批准；這能幫助團隊判斷分工，不代表已證明省時、安全保證或香港亦可接入。
article.detail_en: This follows Anthropic statements in direct reporting, not our product trial. Research preview and beta remain testing stages; a personal waitlist is distinct from enabled business access. Log proposals, completed work and approval requests for one meeting task to assess delegation. No time-saving, security certification or Hong Kong availability is established.
